title: Self-learning axis verified unoccupied (5-axis split); judge is the moat; "Darwin" codename collides — rename before public launch
summary: B4 sweep (2026-06-10, /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/scratch/competitive/B4-selflearning-competitors.md) of the self-learning axis: no product holds all five axes (what-it-learns / external-metric judging / rival attempts / production coupling / cross-task transfer). Products (Devin Knowledge, Windsurf/Augment memories, claude-reflect) have coupling+persistence+transfer but human-only validation, no rival attempts; research systems (Darwin Gödel Machine, AlphaEvolve/OpenEvolve/ShinkaEvolve, SICA, GEPA) have metrics+rival populations but are offline, no production coupling. Market evidence the JUDGE is the moat: Cursor REMOVED its Memories feature in 2.1.x — unjudged memory accretion fails in production. Threats: Cognition fastest productizer (Devin auto-generates Repo Knowledge but validates by human accept/dismiss only); a startup wrapping OpenEvolve/ShinkaEvolve (pip-installable, MCP-wrapped) is 6-12mo out, missing only metric-UX + work-graph. CODENAME: Sakana's Darwin Gödel Machine owns "Darwin" in exactly our category, plus getdarwin.ai ($11.2M, "self-learning AI employee") — fine internally, rename before public positioning. Claim: the productized, work-graph-coupled, honest-benchmark instantiation; never conceptual novelty over DGM/AlphaEvolve.
